In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3.  Vikash Kumar Ravi @ Vikash Kumar aged about 27 years, S/o Jhamlal Ram
All are residents of village & PO Harli, P.S.-Barkagaon, Dist.-Hazaribagh-825311  .... .... Petitioners  Versus  The State of Jharkhand ... .... Opp.
Party CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPAK ROSHAN

For the Petitioners : Mr. Pramod Kumar, Advocate For the Respondent-State : Mr. Sudhir Kumar Mahto, A.P.P.
 ------

Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Piparwar P.S. Case No. 30/2023 for the offences registered under Sections 498A, 302/34 of IPC.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners have been falsely implicated in this case.

He further submits that post-mortem report does not reveal any external injuries on the body of deceased and petitioners have no criminal antecedent, as such they may be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
4. Learned A.P.P. opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.
5. Having regard to the facts of the case and looking to the allegations made against these petitioners, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioners on anticipatory bail.

Accordingly, the petitioners are directed to surrender before the court below within a period of four weeks from today and the learned court below on their surrender shall release them on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.
20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand Only) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the Jhamlal Ram Aged About 47 Years vs The State Of Jharkhand ... .... Opp

. ... on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5612261/
1 satisfaction of learned S.D.J.M, Chatra in connection with Piparwar P.S. Case No. 30/2023, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 482(2) of BNSS, 2023.
6.
It is made clear that if the petitioner will not cooperate in investigation/trial, the State would be at liberty to take appropriate action.
